profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company, traded under the ticker DELL, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Its site describes it as providing technology solutions, services and support, and selling laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming hardware and accessories.

The site's front page gives prominence to Copilot+ PCs, which Dell describes as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, along with the Dell 14 Plus. It also promotes Alienware systems with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series graphics, the Dell 14S and Dell 16S laptops, and PowerEdge servers for business, which the company describes as offering performance, security and scalability. No individual AI products are recorded among the company's tracked products.

Corporate records list Dell under CIK 0001571996. Its recorded litigation exposure is 125 cases in Texas, with no individual case details listed.
